display.purpose: Brand headlines and major product statements only — page H1s, business name on the report.

ui.purpose: Navigation, body, forms, tables — the default.

data.purpose: Scores, rank positions, URLs, scan metadata — tabular figures.

shadows.name: shadow-elevated
shadows.purpose: Reserved for the AuthorityGauge only — the one element per screen meant to visually lift.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one solid-fill action per screen — Run a Scout Scan, submit audit.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #C8FF3D; color: #07090D; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #D6FF66; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C8FF3D; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Severity Badge
components.description: Status/severity pill — maps to the four official status colors only.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-badge-critical { background: rgba(255,92,104,0.15); color: #FF5C68; border-color: rgba(255,92,104,0.3); }

components.name: Card
components.description: The system's container — report sections, dashboard rows.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #10141B; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 14px; } .ds-card-header { padding: 20px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #F4F7FA; } .ds-card-body { padding: 20px 24px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form fields on the audit intake form.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #151B24; color: #F4F7FA; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #C8FF3D; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7E8998; }

components.name: AuthorityGauge
components.description: Signature component: the overall score display. The only element using the 22px radius and the elevation shadow.
components.css: .ds-gauge { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; background: #10141B; border-radius: 22px; border-width: 2px; border-style: solid; padding: 24px 32px; box-shadow: 0 18px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.28); } .ds-gauge-dominant { border-color: rgba(216,180,90,0.5); color: #D8B45A; } .ds-gauge-number { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 3rem; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-gauge-suffix { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #7E8998; margin-top: 4px; } .ds-gauge-label { margin-top: 12px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Processing Stage Row
components.description: Signature component: a real (non-simulated) stage-progress row driven by persisted audit_events.
components.html: • Comparing the local competitor field
components.css: .ds-stage-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); background: #10141B; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #7E8998; } .ds-stage-dot { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-stage-active { border-color: rgba(200,255,61,0.4); background: rgba(200,255,61,0.12); color: #F4F7FA; } .ds-stage-active .ds-stage-dot { border-color: #C8FF3D; animation: ds-pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.4; } }

narrative.overview: A local-intelligence command center for home-service operators — not a generic SaaS dashboard, not an 'AI tool' performing intelligence. Backgrounds sit in four close obsidian-to-slate tones; two brand colors — signal lime for action, authority gold for the score itself — carry almost all of the color budget, with radar cyan reserved for 'opportunity' framing. The logo's own radar/scope motif is the literal source of the 'signal' and 'radar_cyan' names.
keyCharacteristics: Two-color brand system: signal lime (action) + authority gold (the score, and only the score)
A translucent white border (rgba(255,255,255,0.08)), not a solid border color
A real elevation shadow reserved for the AuthorityGauge only
Three-typeface system: Space Grotesk (headlines) / Inter (UI) / IBM Plex Mono (numbers/data)

rules.name: The Two-Color Rule
rules.body: Signal and Authority Gold never both appear as the primary color on the same element. Signal means 'click me / this is active.' Authority Gold means 'this is the score.'

rules.name: The Three-Role Rule
rules.body: A typeface signals what kind of content something is: Space Grotesk = brand statement, Inter = interface, IBM Plex Mono = measured number/raw data.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: shadow-elevated exists for exactly one purpose: the AuthorityGauge. Every other surface uses tone + border only.

dos: Do keep Signal (lime) and Authority Gold mutually exclusive as primary colors on any one element.
Do use the four official status colors for severity/state — critical/warning/success/opportunity — never a fifth.
Do use Space Grotesk only for brand headlines, Inter for everything else, IBM Plex Mono for scores/data.
Do reserve shadow-elevated for the AuthorityGauge alone.
donts: Don't invent new hex values outside this token set.
Don't apply the AuthorityGauge's shadow or 22px radius to ordinary cards.
Don't claim a data source or capability in copy that isn't actually implemented.
Don't use gradients, glow, or glassmorphism anywhere.
